name: manley-vari-mu-master-ms-glue
description: Mid/Side mastering glue via the UADx Manley Variable Mu — the move the MONO Fairchild 660 can't do. IN/OUT MATRIX M-S, controls + sidechain UNLINKED so the MID (L-channel controls) and SIDE (R-channel controls) compress independently. Glue the mid ~1 dB (l_thresh 6), leave the sides nearly open (r_thresh 9) → tighter centre + slightly wider, more cohesive master. Slow ATTACK 2, RECOVERY 'Med Slo', COMP, HP SIDECHAIN 'In'. VALIDATED on the Watercolors warm drum bus: correlation 0.975->0.956, stereo width -18.9->-16.4 dB (wider), LRA 2.44->1.93 (tighter), crest 17.17->17.65 (up), true-peak -0.99 — centre cohesion + a touch wider, the move the mono 660 can't do.
intended_for: a near-final stereo mix / master bus that wants centre cohesion without squashing the stereo sides (a true-stereo M/S glue stage; hand off to master-track for limiting)
plugin_build: uaudio_manley_variable_mu.vst3 (UADx native build — renders headless; the /Components/UAD Manley Variable Mu.component twin passes through offline, do not use it).
notes: In M-S mode the L-channel controls act on the MID and the R-channel controls act on the SIDE (measured: lowering l_thresh widened the image). UNLINK sc_link + ctrl_link so they're independent.
Squeezing the MID harder than the SIDE WIDENS the master (measured: correlation 0.977->0.933, width -19.2->-14.5 dB). To NARROW/centre instead, compress the SIDE harder (lower r_thresh).
Keep it gentle (~1 dB on the mid). This is a glue/imaging stage, not a leveler — hand off to master-track for loudness + the true-peak limiter.
Harness-only (enum params). LINKED M-S == L-R (no imaging change) — the unlink is the whole point.
